description: Provenance gate benchmark scenarios for the send_message count/absence gates. Replays Ed Rivera's real June 2026 failure classes (must_block=true) plus honest-message controls (must_block=false) to measure detection rate and false-positive rate before enabling enforce mode. Each scenario sets up session receipts, then evaluates a candidate outbound message.
